name: Ashish Ranjan
title: Senior Software Engineer | React, Next.js, Full-Stack & AI Integration
summary: Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience building secure, scalable web products with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and AWS. Frontend-first, with full-stack ownership across component architecture, performance, authentication, and cloud data workflows. Additional hands-on experience integrating RAG workflows with embeddings, vector retrieval, and Gemini, while continuing to build practical knowledge of agentic AI.

description: Built scalable, responsive, and accessible web interfaces with React, Next.js, TypeScript, React Query, reusable components, lazy loading, and code splitting.

Designed and built the core of an ETL-inspired CRM migration platform that processed billions of records and transferred associated files between CRM systems. Implemented parallel processing with Node.js and Amazon SQS, checkpointing and retries with DynamoDB, safe job resumption, and scalable deployment on AWS ECS.
Implemented an end-to-end encrypted file-sharing platform with secure client-side encryption, key handling, and shared-key access for private and shared file workflows.
Integrated AWS Cognito and NextAuth authentication, SignalR real-time updates, security headers, SBOM generation, dependency scanning, and CI/CD security checks.
Upgraded and maintained React Native applications, integrated Firebase Cloud Messaging, and supported stable App Store and Play Store releases.
Built a document-focused RAG workflow using Hugging Face embeddings, vector retrieval, and Gemini for contextual responses; currently expanding practical knowledge of agentic AI patterns.
Developed responsive product experiences with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and reusable frontend components.
Implemented Redux Toolkit state management and contributed to a micro-frontend architecture that supported independently maintained features.
Improved rendering and data-fetching behavior by diagnosing frontend bottlenecks and simplifying component and state flows.
Contributed to React Native applications, deployment workflows with Nginx and PM2, code reviews, technical documentation, and intern mentoring.
Developed enterprise web interfaces with React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, React Hooks, Context API, and React Router.
Built and integrated REST APIs with Node.js, Express, and MongoDB for full-stack product features.
Delivered responsive, cross-device interfaces in collaboration with product, design, backend, and quality teams.
Developed an online research and development portal with React and SQL in collaboration with institute stakeholders.
